basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 9.' and it opens 'Vers. 9. Vocabis nomen ejus Ismael. Qui auditio interpretatur. Quia enim angelus dixit:'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 9. Vocabis nomen ejus Ismael. Qui auditio interpretatur. Quia enim angelus dixit: Eo quod audierat Dominus vocem tuam, hinc sumpta etymologia vocatus est Ismael, id est auditio.
